manual.title: Correcting and transferring annotations with a language model
manual.description: Let a language model correct the annotation of a document, or carry over the annotation of another version, each into a new version.

manual.description: Transfer the annotation of an earlier version to a new extraction of the same document.

manual.title: Testing a model with the current document
manual.description: Measure how well a model corrects a document whose annotation is known to be right.
